findings.expected: Use a French banner (e.g. banner-fr.png) reading « Un financement adapté à vos projets — Taux concurrentiels. Modalités claires. Aucune surprise. »
findings.description: The French landing page displays the English banner image, with English text "Financing that fits your plans / Competitive rates. Clear terms. No surprises."
The subtitle uses the informal "tu" while the heading directly above and the rest of the site use "vous".
"Appliquer pour" is a well-known anglicism (calque of "apply for") that the OQLF advises against; the correct term is "faire une demande de prêt" or "Demander un prêt".
The site footer is still in English on French pages, including the English brand name "Northstar Bank" instead of "Banque Northstar".

findings.expected: Let the button grow with its content (remove fixed width/overflow hidden) or shorten to "Soumettre la demande"
findings.description: The French submit button label is clipped: visible text is "Soumettre ma demande", the words "de prêt" are cut off (scrollWidth 290 > clientWidth 210, overflow hidden, nowrap).
On empty submission, the full-name validation error is shown in English on the French form, while the other fields show the French message.
The field label uses "e-mail" (not standard in Quebec French) while its own validation message says "adresse courriel"; two different terms for the same concept.

findings.observed: Merci. Votre demande pour {montant} a été reçue.
findings.expected: Merci. Votre demande de 15 000,00 $ a été reçue.
findings.description: The confirmation message shows the raw template variable "{montant}" instead of the loan amount; the French placeholder name was translated so it no longer matches the variable supplied.
The French application confirmation page declares html lang="en" although its content is French (other French pages declare fr-CA).
"Balance" is an anglicism for an account balance; the correct banking term in French is "solde".
In French, zero takes the singular; the English plural rule was applied, giving "0 prêts actifs".
The transactions section heading is left in English on the French dashboard.
Transaction dates in the French table use the US MM/DD/YYYY format (09/15/2026, 09/12/2026, 09/08/2026), which is ambiguous and not a fr-CA convention; English shows ISO dates.
A bank "statement" is a "relevé" in French; "déclaration" means a declaration (e.g. tax return), which is wrong in this context.
The "Estimer un nouveau prêt" link on the French dashboard points to the English calculator (/en/calculator), switching the user to English.
The "Pay later" option is translated as "Payer maintenant" (pay now), the opposite meaning, contradicting its own help text about a deferred first payment.
The estimated monthly payment on the French calculator uses English currency formatting (leading $, decimal point) instead of the fr-CA format.

findings.observed: Aucune accusation pour un remboursement anticipé.
findings.expected: Aucuns frais pour un remboursement anticipé.
findings.description: "Charges" (fees) was translated as "accusation" (a criminal charge); the correct term is "frais" or "pénalité".

findings.expected: Taux variable de 5,2 %, sous réserve de l'approbation du crédit.
findings.description: The French rate note drops the condition "subject to credit approval", presenting the rate as unconditional.

findings.expected: Use the French counterpart of promo-a.png showing « Taux variable : 5,2 % »
findings.description: The French page shows a different promo image (promo-c.png) advertising a fixed rate of 4.9%, contradicting its alt text and the page content (variable rate 5.2%) and the English image.
The modal close link "Close" was translated as the adjective "Proche" (near) instead of the verb "Fermer".

findings.observed: Not Found — The requested URL was not found on the server. If you entered the URL manually please check your spelling and try again.
findings.expected: Page introuvable — La page demandée n'existe pas. Si vous avez saisi l'adresse manuellement, vérifiez-en l'orthographe.
findings.description: The 404 error page under /fr/ is the server's default English page, with no French text or site navigation.

findings.expected: Parse amounts using fr-CA conventions (space as thousands separator, comma as decimal separator)
findings.description: The French loan form rejects an amount typed in the French format ("12 500,50", within the allowed range) with an out-of-range error, so French users entering amounts the way the site itself displays them cannot submit.
